subject: Weekly forecast submission — rapid sync & ownership ask
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly forecast submission — rapid sync & ownership ask

Hi team,

Quick reminder — our weekly forecast submission window opens at 3pm PT today. Please do the following before the 2:45pm handoff: 

- Update committed deals in the spreadsheet (attached: Q3_forecast_template_v2.xlsx). Only include deals with internal approval or strong close signals.
- Flag any late-stage risk (sales/ops/blockers column) and add one-sentence mitigation.
- Attach evidence for deals >$75k in the Evidence column (use evidence_roster_template.csv).

Call details (15 min): 2:50pm PT, Zoom (link in the Drive doc). Agenda: 1) quick lane updates (30s each), 2) risky deals escalation (2-3), 3) commit confirmation and submission.

Specific asks:
- Aditya: please confirm if ACME (ACME-2026-Q3) should move to Commit before the call — I left a note on the row about the procurement timeline.
- Vanessa: can you surface the evidence packet for the top five deals?
- Marissa: I may need an escalation if ACME is still in procurement queue.

Keep notes short. If you won't make the 2:50pm sync, ping me with your commit signal and I'll represent your lane.

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes
Sr. RevOps Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- Q3_forecast_template_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45KB stub)
- evidence_roster_template.csv (csv, 4KB stub)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly forecast submission — rapid sync & ownership ask

Camila — thanks for the heads-up. Quick updates: 

- I will update the ACME row by 2:30pm with conservative Commit + procurement ETA (they asked for updated SOW by EOD).
- For ACME-2026-Q3: current blocker is legal sign-off on the data residency Annex. Procurement is waiting on the Annex; I flagged legal to prioritize.
- I'll include a one-line mitigation recommending a 2-week payment hold contingency if Annex slips.

If legal can't greenlight by 2:30pm, mark ACME as Late-Stage (Commit-at-risk) and I'll drop a note calling out the exact dependency.

On the call I'll run lane summary for EMEA deals assigned to me.

—Aditya
